claims.quote: We present a case of a girl with a DEE characterized by a Rett-like phenotype in association with febrile and afebrile clusters of focal seizures.

claims.object_text: febrile and afebrile clusters of focal seizures
claims.quote: We present a case of a girl with a DEE characterized by a Rett-like phenotype in association with febrile and afebrile clusters of focal seizures.
The girl presented typical development until the age of 18 months, followed by regression.
The first febrile bilateral tonic-clonic seizure was observed at 30 months of age,

claims.object_text: seizure clusters (several episodes per day every 10 days)
claims.quote: the following month seizures recurred in clusters of several episodes per day every 10 days.

claims.object_text: behavioural arrest, emotional symptoms, head turning, followed by bilateral tonic-clonic seizures
claims.quote: These seizures were characterized by behavioural arrest, emotional symptoms, head turning, and followed by bilateral tonic-clonic seizures.

claims.object_text: valproic acid and levetiracetam (led to prolonged seizure control)
claims.quote: The administration of valproic acid and levetiracetam led to prolonged seizure control.

claims.object_text: monthly recurrent clusters of focal seizures and non-convulsive status epilepticus
claims.quote: However, from the age of 7 years, she had monthly recurrent clusters of focal seizures and non-convulsive status epilepticus which occurred at different ages.
Brain and spinal cord MRI showed mild non-progressive hemispheric cerebellar atrophy.
